description: This file defines the TerminationReasonConfigurationAPI class in a Human Resource Management system. It provides REST API endpoints for managing 'Termination Reasons' including listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting termination reason entries. It includes OpenAPI annotations for API documentation and interacts with a service layer for data operations.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationAPI
classes.description: This PHP class provides API endpoints for managing termination reasons within the HRM system, supporting CRUD operations with validation, service interactions, and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonConfigurationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the TerminationReasonConfigurationService instance used for business logic and data operations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of termination reasons with optional sorting and pagination, returning a collection result for API response.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new termination reason entry by accepting input parameters and saving via the service, returning the created model.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Helper method that sets the name on a TerminationReason entity and persists it through the service layer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes termination reasons based on provided IDs, after validation, and returns the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a single termination reason by ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing termination reason identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for parameters used in listing termination reasons.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new termination reason.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting termination reasons, ensuring IDs are valid and not in use.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rule for retrieving a single termination reason by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an existing termination reason, including uniqueness validation.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the 'name' parameter, enforcing string type, length, and uniqueness constraints.
